description: A supply chain director must decide whether to release an arriving 600-kilogram shipment of battery-grade graphite powder for production and finalize its receiving, customs, and combustible-dust storage controls, with input from quality, logistics, and environmental health and safety.

shared_context.S1: A 600-kilogram shipment of battery-grade graphite powder arrived at the plant this morning and is staged at receiving.
shared_context.S2: The graphite is needed for a scheduled electrode-compounding run later this week.
shared_context.S3: The shipment's supplier, product description, and quantity match the purchase order.
shared_context.S4: Mara's receiving routine is a mandatory round-robin: she calls on quality, logistics, and environmental health and safety in order, and each gives one report of all release requirements and the current completion status before Mara decides.
shared_context.S5: The round-robin ends with Mara's binding decision in the same meeting; a conditional release authorizes the full shipment subject to documented follow-up commitments, while a hold means no quantity is released.

PF1.text: Eli's receiving sample test found moisture at 0.14%, below the internal maximum of 0.20%; the graphite release procedure requires samples from exactly 3 locations in the shipment, and he completed that check this morning but has not yet entered it in the electronic lot record.

PF2.text: Nora's carrier call confirmed that the container seal number differs from the number on the shipping notice; customs allows conditional release only if the discrepancy is documented in a receiving exception record, which she confirmed with the broker this morning but has not yet filed.

PF3.text: Victor's combustible-dust review requires this graphite to be moved into grounded metal bins with lids before production use; the ordinary raw-material rack is not approved for this powder, and he completed the review this morning but has not yet posted the storage instruction.

acceptance_conditions: The shipment must receive conditional release for production.
Receiving must use samples from exactly 3 locations.
The maximum accepted moisture must be set at exactly 0.20 percent.
The graphite must be stored in grounded metal bins with lids.
A receiving exception record for the seal discrepancy must be committed.
The quality test finding must be cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: The 0.14 percent result supports releasing all 600 kilograms, while the exact procedure requires 3 sample locations and a 0.20 percent maximum moisture limit.
The seal discrepancy changes the shipment from ordinary release to conditional release and requires a receiving exception record before customs can clear it.
The combustible-dust review changes the storage assignment from the ordinary raw-material rack to grounded metal bins with lids.
